A full Serie A midweek round runs from Tuesday to Thursday, with Lazio at Sassuolo, Milan hosting Bologna and Inter visiting Venezia. Here are the decimal odds on all 10 games at Canadian sportsbooks, the best price on each result and total, and five bets for Matchweek 9. The best defense in Serie A is priced above 2.00 on Tuesday, and that is the place to start Matchweek 9. Lazio have conceded five goals in eight games and are level with Inter on 22 points at the top, yet every book compared has them above 2.00 in Sassuolo. Atalanta as the underdog against a bottom-three Fiorentina is the other price that looks wrong. Standings and stats run through Matchweek 8. Odds are decimal and were compared at 1xBet, Tonybet, 22Bet, BetLabel, 20Bet, Granawin and 29Black. For more markets, see the full list of sports betting lines . Sassuolo Vs Lazio Tuesday, Oct. 27, 1:30 p.m. ET, Mapei Stadium Lazio are 7-1-0 with 16 goals scored and only five conceded. They won 3-0 in Turin against Juventus and beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday. Sassuolo are 14th, 2-2-4, and have conceded 16 goals; they lost 2-0 at Como last time out. Lazio at 2.24 at 1xBet is the standout price of the round. The other books are at 2.14 to 2.15, including 20Bet and Granawin at 2.14, so the 1xBet price is worth taking. The risk is a Sassuolo team that has scored 12 goals and could make this a tighter game than Lazio would like. The pick: Lazio to win at 2.24 at 1xBet. Statistics Torino Vs Como Tuesday, Oct. 27, 3:45 p.m. ET, Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino Como are fifth on 17 points and have conceded seven goals; they won 3-1 in Florence and 2-0 at home to Sassuolo. Torino are on 13 points after back-to-back wins over Parma (3-0) and Monza (3-2). Che Adams has three goals for Torino, and Anastasios Douvikas has five for Como. Torino's two wins came against teams in the bottom half, and Como are the better side on both goals scored and goals conceded. 1xBet's 1.82 is clearly better than the 1.73 to 1.75 elsewhere. The pick: Como to win at 1.82 at 1xBet. They drew 3-3 at Napoli on Saturday. Cagliari have scored six goals in eight games and lost 4-0 at Monza and 2-0 at home to Bologna. At 1.39 or shorter, Roma are not worth backing on the result. The total is where the value is. Cagliari have barely scored, Roma have barely conceded, and under 2.5 is available at 2.31 at 1xBet. The risk is that Roma score three or more by themselves. The pick: Under 2.5 goals at 2.31 at 1xBet. Bologna are 13th, 2-2-4, have scored only eight goals and lost 3-1 at home to Inter before winning 2-0 at Cagliari. Milan at home against one of the league's weakest attacks is a straightforward choice. The best price is 1.69 at 1xBet.
